slug: 2024-09-24 Egypt deploys automated civil-registry kiosks (birth certificates and national ID)

systems.tiers: touchscreen kiosks in major malls: an initial 8 offices expanded to 16 locations (Cairo, Giza, Gharbia, Alexandria, Hurghada, Cairo Airport and others), issuing birth, death, marriage and divorce certificates and national-ID application forms after fingerprint or face check (2024)

note: Kiosks issue copies of certificates and identity-card forms; the document says nothing of how a birth or death is first registered.
